tools.name: coo_control_status
tools.description: Report whether the Coo Control behaviour patch is applied: Coopanion and desktop-pet versions, the state of body.js and pet-app.js, the backup location, the current preset, whether the AI may edit it, and the last error. Read-only.

summary.zh: 查看控制权回交是否生效：Coopanion/桌宠版本、两个补丁文件的状态、备份位置、当前预设和上次错误。
summary.en: Reports whether Coo Control is in effect: app and desktop-pet versions, both patched files, backups, the current preset and the last error.

tools.name: coo_control_get
tools.description: Return the current behaviour policy as JSON: idle action and face weights, click and petting face weights, hop/sit-sleep chances, and whether heart particles are allowed. Read-only; use the keys in this JSON with coo_control_set.

summary.zh: 读取当前行为策略：待机动作/表情权重、点击/摸头表情权重、跳跃/睡着概率、是否允许爱心。
summary.en: Returns the current behaviour policy: idle action and face weights, click and petting face weights, hop/sit-sleep chances and the heart setting.

tools.name: coo_control_set
tools.description: Change how the pet body reacts by default. A preset (expressive, reserved, cold, custom) is the quick way; overrides are flat policy keys from coo_control_get, each 0–100 (0 disables). Overrides switch the preset to custom. The change is written to the running pet within about two seconds; no restart. Only allowed while the user keeps "Allow the AI to change it" on; ask with pet_ask first unless the user already asked for a specific change.

preset.description: expressive = stock; reserved = no hearts on click, shy when petted; cold = neutral/surprised/angry, no hearts; custom = use the overrides / saved custom weights.

overrides.description: Flat policy keys from coo_control_get, e.g. {"pokeLove":0,"petShy":100,"idleLove":0,"pokeHop":20}. Each is 0–100; 0 disables.

hearts.description: Whether the "love" face may emit heart particles. Defaults to the preset/custom setting when omitted.

summary.zh: 修改桌宠默认行为：用预设（活泼/内敛/高冷/自定义）或按 coo_control_get 的键给 0–100 权重；约两秒内生效，无需重启。
summary.en: Changes the default behaviour by preset or by 0–100 weights on coo_control_get keys; applies in about two seconds without a restart.

tools.name: coo_control_reset
tools.description: Reset the behaviour policy to the stock expressive preset and clear the custom weights. The change is written to the running pet within about two seconds; no restart.

summary.zh: 恢复原版「活泼」预设，清空自定义权重；约两秒内生效。
summary.en: Restores the stock expressive preset and clears custom weights; applies in about two seconds.

tools.name: coo_control_apply
tools.description: Re-apply the Coo Control patch to the installed desktop-pet files. Idempotent; writes backups first; refuses unknown code instead of guessing. Use after a Coopanion update, or when auto-apply is off. If the pet window is already running, restart Coopanion afterwards.

summary.zh: 给当前安装的 Coopanion 重打行为补丁：先备份、可重复执行；不认识的新代码会拒绝。更新 Coopanion 后用它。
summary.en: Re-applies the behaviour patch to the installed Coopanion; backs up first, idempotent, refuses unknown code. Use after a Coopanion update.

tools.name: coo_control_restore
tools.description: Restore body.js and pet-app.js from the backups this extension made and remove the generated policy file, undoing the patch. Refuses when the current files no longer match what this extension wrote. Restart Coopanion afterwards.

summary.zh: 用本扩展的备份还原 body.js / pet-app.js 并删掉策略文件，撤销补丁；当前文件对不上时拒绝覆盖；之后重启 Coopanion。
summary.en: Restores body.js and pet-app.js from this extension’s backups, removes the generated policy, and refuses when the files no longer match; restart Coopanion afterwards.
